Neuroscience · Medicine · Research · Writing

I’m Fharell — a student exploring neuroscience, medicine, and the science of the human brain.

I’m interested in how we understand the brain, how research becomes medicine, and how scientific knowledge can ultimately be used to help people.

What I’m working on

🧠 Neuroscience

Learning about the brain, nervous system, and the mechanisms behind neurological disease.

🔬 Research

Exploring research opportunities and building the foundation for a future in biomedical and neurological research.

🩺 Medicine

Working toward a career in medicine while learning what it means to care for patients, conduct research, and contribute to better healthcare.

✍️ Writing

A place for my thoughts, observations, projects, and things I’m learning along the way.

Currently

I’m building my foundation in biology, chemistry, neuroscience, and research while documenting the process here.

This site is a record of that journey — the things I learn, the questions I have, and the work I want to do.
